title: OIL PRICE WATCH: Diesel, kerosene may see up to P3.70/L rollback on Dec. 1
summary: MANILA — Motorists may see another round of oil price rollbacks on Dec. 1, with diesel and kerosene prices expected to go down by as much as P3.70 per liter.
